image_description: A low-light, high-contrast photograph of a live concert performance. The central subject is a musician on stage wearing a dark jacket with gold trim and holding a microphone. To the right, another band member is partially visible near a drum kit. The background features stage lighting rigs, blue spotlights, and a red 'EXIT' sign. The foreground contains the silhouette of an audience member's head.

The red sign resembles an 'EXIT' sign but the characters are distorted and illegible, lacking the sharp geometric precision of real signage.
